get.summary: Whether the API can reach its database and object storage.
The token every state-changing request must send in the X-CSRF-TOKEN header.

post.summary: Signs a member in with email and password and starts their session.

get.summary: Who is signed in, and their Organization.
One render job and the state it is in.

post.summary: Cancels a job that is queued or running. The worker stops what it is doing and keeps nothing of it. Cancelling a cancelled job changes nothing.

get.summary: The Organization's settings.

put.summary: Changes the Organization's settings. Owners only.

get.summary: The Organization's members, by email.

post.summary: Adds an Editor to the Organization. Owners only.

get.summary: The sensitive actions taken in the Organization, newest first. Owners only.
The Organization's Products, by name. Search looks in the name; category and status narrow the list.

post.summary: Creates a Product. Its URLs are stored as text and never fetched.

get.summary: Every category the Organization's Products use, in alphabetical order.
One Product.

put.summary: Replaces a Product's details. An archived Product can still be edited.

post.summary: Archives a Product. Archiving one that is already archived changes nothing.

get.summary: The Product's photos and logo, oldest first.

post.summary: Adds a photo, or sets the logo, from a JPEG, PNG or WebP file. The file is decoded and kept as a PNG; a new logo takes the place of the old one.

get.summary: The image, as a PNG.

delete.summary: Removes a photo or the logo, and its file.

get.summary: The Product's Facts, oldest first. State narrows the list to Proposed, Confirmed or Withdrawn.

post.summary: Adds a Fact to the Product. It starts as Proposed.

get.summary: One Fact.

post.summary: Confirms a Proposed Fact in the member's name. Answers 409 for a Fact in any other state.
Withdraws a Proposed or Confirmed Fact. Answers 409 for one that is already Withdrawn.
How a Fact is edited: withdraws it and adds a new Proposed Fact, which is the answer. Answers 409 for a Fact that is already Withdrawn.

get.summary: The Organization's Projects, newest first. A Product narrows the list to the Projects made from it.

post.summary: Creates a Project from one Product, with its brief. The brief cannot be changed afterwards.

get.summary: One Project.

delete.summary: Deletes a Project with its Variants and their Storyboards. The Product is kept. Answers 409 when a Rendered Video was made from one of its Storyboards.

get.summary: The Project's Variants, oldest first.

post.summary: Adds a Variant to the Project: a creative template and a Hook.

get.summary: One Variant.

post.summary: Adds a separate Variant with the same creative template and a new Hook, which is the answer. The Variant that was duplicated is not changed.

get.summary: The Variant's Storyboard versions, newest first.

post.summary: Plans the Variant's next Storyboard version in Product Lock from the Product's Confirmed Facts and photos, with the mock planner and no AI. Answers 409 with the reason when it cannot: no Confirmed Fact, no usable photo, a creative template other than Product Showcase, or a Hook, Fact or Product name too long for its layout.

get.summary: One version of the Variant's Storyboard.

post.summary: Queues a job that renders this Storyboard version in Product Lock. The worker renders it; ask for the job to see its state. A request repeated with the same Idempotency-Key is answered 200 with the job the first one queued.

get.summary: The jobs that render this Storyboard version, newest first.
One Rendered Video.
The MP4, to preview in the browser.
